summary: Renames ID-list fields in admin request bodies (roles/menus/scopes/rules to *_ids); breaks old API callers.

statements.why: Auth unchanged and the breaking rename isn't a login/payment/DB/secret issue, though it is something the owner must know (see misses).

statements.text: The agent changed the sys data scope rules, sys role menus and sys role scopes parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Names real changed routes; omits POST/PUT /sys/users and doesn't say fields were renamed.

statements.text: The agent also changed crud_data_scope.py, crud_role.py, crud_user.py, schema/data_scope.py, schema/role.py and 4 more files, in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Admin API request fields renamed (roles/menus/scopes/rules to role_ids/menu_ids/scope_ids/rule_ids) on create user, edit user, edit role menus, role scopes and data-scope rules. Admin UI must be updated at the same time or saves fail with 422.
Creating/editing users (role assignment) is affected too, not just rules/menus/scopes.
